text: When Israel (he wrestles with God) departed from Egypt (land of bondage), the house of Jacob (he grasps the heel) from a people of foreign tongue,
Judah (praised) became God’s sanctuary, Israel (he wrestles with God) His dominion.
The sea observed and fled; the Jordan (flowing down) turned back;
the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan (flowing down), that you turned back,
O mountains, that you⁺ skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob (he grasps the heel),
who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
